result.title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
result.summary: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建了标准化 RNA 分子动力学基准 RNADynBench（2585 条 100-ns 全原子轨迹，含防泄漏划分），并提出统一模型 RNADynNet，用共享主干同时完成轨迹生成与从单构象中提取动力学指纹。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线（视觉/多模态推理）距离较远，但其「单帧观测推断潜在演化状态」与「生成与表示共享主干并对齐」的设定，可能为 latent 状态的表示-生成耦合及证据不足时的动态外推提供概念类比，需人工核查可迁移性。
